scenes.description: Cold-open evidence. A translucent 3D-printed pin and hole appear to align perfectly against a ghosted CAD outline, then the physical pair jams halfway. Subject: fused precision parts with visible layer texture. Subject motion: smooth insertion, sudden stop, one micro-vibration under force. Scene: graphite workshop void, narrow inspection beam, no text except the separate red measurement overlay. Spatial framing: extreme macro, pin axis diagonal from lower-left to upper-right, shallow foreground burrs and a clean CAD ghost in the midground. Camera: 85 mm macro equivalent, low angle, shallow focus, controlled 4% dolly-in. The signature red gap gauge appears at 0.00 for the first of only two uses.
scenes.framing: Extreme macro diagonal composition; physical surfaces dominate 80% of frame, CAD ghost offset behind them.
scenes.movement: Ease-in insertion for 2.2s, hard mechanical stop, two-frame impact tremor, slow dolly toward the fused interface.
scenes.overlay_notes: Bottom-safe captions. At top-right, red monospaced gauge: CLEARANCE 0.00. No headline duplication.
scenes.shot_intent: Prove the paradox physically before explaining it; the viewer should feel the jam by second three.
scenes.information_role: Zero nominal gap can become real interference.

required_assets.description: 16:9 macro style anchor: translucent amber 3D-printed cylindrical pin jammed halfway into a dark graphite socket, visible fine layer texture and a thin inspection light, physically plausible materials, no labels, no text, no hands, room for captions in lower center; Measured Friction palette.

scenes.description: Title card built as a forensic case slate rather than a stock hero component. Subject: a warm drawing-stock evidence card stamped BUILD FAILURE FORENSICS / CASE 001. Subject motion: the card slides under a brass caliper jaw; the jaw closes once and registers the title with a dry click. Scene: wide negative-space graphite field with brass tool silhouettes at the edge. Spatial framing: centered card occupies 55% width, strong empty right third for breathing room. Camera: virtual 50 mm, straight-on, deep focus, static except a 1% settle after the stamp.
scenes.framing: Wide centered evidence slate with large negative space and exact mobile-safe title bounds.
scenes.movement: Card slides in from below with weighted deceleration; brass jaw presses; title ink resolves through a subtle deboss shadow.
scenes.transition_out: brass jaw sweeps frame into a CAD axis line
scenes.overlay_notes: Title is the primary on-screen text; captions are suppressed for the spoken series-name phrase to avoid duplication, then resume for the rest of the line.
scenes.shot_intent: Brand the series as a sequence of engineering case files and reset pace after the aggressive hook.
scenes.information_role: Names the series and establishes the evidence-first promise.

scenes.description: Act I, ideal geometry. Subject: a clean CAD cross-section with a 10.00 mm pin and a 10.00 mm hole touching on a shared centerline. Subject motion: construction lines draw in; dimension arrows extend; both values lock with clinical perfection. Scene: pale drafting field with sparse graphite grid and steel-cyan geometry. Spatial framing: insert-style cross-section centered at 60% width, dimension callouts above and below, no fake camera depth. Camera: N/A as a native vector diagram; simulate a precise 6% zoom-in to focus attention.
scenes.framing: Insert diagram, centered axis, generous margins, measurement labels outside the active geometry.
scenes.movement: Stroke-draw geometry in assembly order, then snap dimension arrows to exact endpoints.
scenes.transition_in: caliper jaw becomes vertical construction line
scenes.transition_out: dimension labels split into upper and lower real-world ranges
scenes.overlay_notes: Only technical labels: PIN 10.00 and HOLE 10.00. Captions remain bottom-center and do not repeat labels.
scenes.shot_intent: Establish the seductive certainty of nominal CAD before introducing variation.
scenes.information_role: CAD records exact nominal values, not the full distribution of real parts.

scenes.description: Act I, the collision. Subject: the nominal pin and hole transform into two physical cross-sections with translucent tolerance halos. Subject motion: pin radius pulses outward while hole radius contracts; halos overlap and the contact boundary flashes warning red. Scene: return to graphite, with faint chalk measurement ticks and no other decorative elements. Spatial framing: close-up centered on the interface; pin enters from left, hole from right; foreground halos slide across the shared boundary. Camera: virtual 85 mm, level, medium depth, slow tracking right following the contact point.
scenes.framing: Close-up split geometry with the collision boundary exactly on the vertical centerline.
scenes.movement: Nominal outlines breathe into tolerance halos; pin high and hole low converge; brief compression ripple communicates interference.
scenes.transition_in: range labels peel off the CAD dimension
scenes.transition_out: red collision line expands into the next scene's tolerance-zone field
scenes.overlay_notes: Small labels PIN HIGH and HOLE LOW appear above the corresponding zones; 'ZERO GAP = TRAP' appears for 0.8s only after the collision, distinct from caption wording.
scenes.shot_intent: Turn abstract manufacturing variation into a visible collision and complete Act I's cause-and-effect chain.
scenes.information_role: Opposite extremes of two valid parts can overlap when no clearance is designed.

scenes.description: Act II definition field. Subject: two horizontal tolerance bands floating around nominal centerlines; beneath them, a separate deliberate clearance band appears between the worst-case edges. Subject motion: tolerance bands oscillate subtly within their ranges, freeze at closest approach, then the chosen clearance band opens. Scene: warm drawing-stock background, cyan ranges, brass nominal lines, red used only at the near-collision edge—not the signature gauge. Spatial framing: medium-wide diagram spanning the frame, labels aligned to left rail. Camera: N/A native diagram; use a restrained downward tilt illusion as the clearance band is revealed.
scenes.framing: Medium-wide editorial diagram: tolerance bands occupy upper two-thirds; clearance explanation occupies lower third.
scenes.movement: Ranges breathe asynchronously, snap to worst case, then separate under a controlled brass measurement bracket.
scenes.transition_in: collision line unfolds horizontally into two range bands
scenes.transition_out: bands fold into three vertical mechanical bays
scenes.overlay_notes: Labels: TOLERANCE = RANGE; CLEARANCE = CHOSEN SPACE. These are definitions, not duplicated full captions.
scenes.shot_intent: Deliver the conceptual hinge slowly enough to distinguish variation from intentional space.
scenes.information_role: Tolerance is a range around nominal; clearance is designed separation between mating surfaces.

scenes.description: Act II mechanical triptych. Subject: three different assemblies—sliding bushing, keyed locating pin, and press-fit boss—each in its own vertical bay. Subject motion: left slider travels freely; center pin seats with a soft click and stops; right boss compresses under a press and locks. Scene: graphite stage divided by thin brass rails, changing accent emphasis per bay. Spatial framing: wide orthographic triptych with all three mechanisms readable simultaneously, then a subtle orbital parallax connects them as one geometry family. Camera: virtual 35 mm, eye-level, deep focus, 3-degree orbital move only during the final summary.
scenes.framing: Wide three-bay composition; mechanisms occupy equal visual weight but animate one at a time left-to-right.
scenes.movement: Three distinct physical actions in rhythmic sequence, ending with all three silhouettes aligned for comparison.
scenes.transition_in: tolerance bands fold into bay dividers
scenes.transition_out: press platen slams down and becomes the top edge of a physical test gauge
scenes.overlay_notes: Short labels only: CLEARANCE / TRANSITION / INTERFERENCE. Captions run below the bays.
scenes.shot_intent: Convert vocabulary into three unforgettable physical jobs with a deliberate rhythmic build.
scenes.information_role: Clearance, transition, and interference fits are functional choices, not quality rankings.

scenes.description: Act III practical test. Subject: a compact 3D-printed fit gauge with five labeled holes and matching pins arranged on a worn work mat. Subject motion: pins are tested in order; first sticks, second wobbles, third begins to slide correctly. Scene: warm overhead workshop pool with graphite edges and real-looking polymer texture; no hands, only tool-like animated motion. Spatial framing: close-up top-down composition, gauge runs diagonally, tested pins queue in the upper right. Camera: virtual 50 mm, overhead, medium depth, controlled rack focus traveling from failed to candidate fit.
scenes.framing: Close overhead tactile insert; diagonal gauge creates forward reading direction from left to right.
scenes.movement: Three pins enter sequentially with distinct contact behavior; focus follows the active test position.
scenes.transition_in: press platen becomes the gauge's top edge
scenes.transition_out: rack focus dives into the winning pin's interface
scenes.overlay_notes: Tiny gauge labels 1–5 are part of the prop; no explanatory headline. Captions remain centered above the lower safe edge.
scenes.shot_intent: Give viewers a cheap, concrete action they can perform before committing a larger build.
scenes.information_role: A small process-specific gauge beats a universal clearance rule.

scenes.description: Act III hero payoff. Subject: the winning pin and hole interface fills the frame. Subject motion: the pin glides through, reverses once without binding, then settles centered. Scene: almost-black void with a single cyan rim; all clutter disappears. Spatial framing: extreme close-up of the moving interface with microscopic texture and a narrow negative-space band at center. Camera: virtual 135 mm macro, shallow focus, perfectly steady, 8% dolly-out revealing the deliberate gap. The signature red clearance gauge returns for the second and final use, opening from 0.00 to TESTED.
scenes.framing: Extreme macro centered on the moving gap; minimal composition reserved for the payoff.
scenes.movement: Smooth low-friction glide, one reverse pass, measurement ticks spring outward and settle with no bounce.
scenes.transition_in: macro dive through gauge position three
scenes.transition_out: inspection light narrows to a slit and becomes the fracture light in scene 09
scenes.overlay_notes: Signature device: red gauge changes from 0.00 to TESTED. No other headline; captions may be suppressed for the exact word 'winning value' if overlap feels redundant.
scenes.shot_intent: Pay off the cold-open jam with visibly effortless motion and the channel's scarce signature motif.
scenes.information_role: The correct value is the one verified by the actual process and function.

scenes.description: Episode-two tease. Subject: a fractured printed bracket rotates slowly in a narrow inspection light; the jagged layer-following crack is the only sharp detail. Subject motion: half-turn reveal, then freeze as CASE 002 appears off to the side. Scene: deep graphite void with no return of the clearance motif. Spatial framing: medium-close object on the left third, right third reserved for the small case number. Camera: virtual 85 mm, slightly high angle, shallow-to-medium focus, slow counter-clockwise orbital move ending static.
scenes.framing: Medium-close fracture evidence on left third; minimal case label on right; large black margins.
scenes.movement: Slow half-orbit reveals the crack plane; motion arrests on the final word 'built.'
scenes.transition_in: light-slit match cut from the winning gap
scenes.transition_out: hard fade to graphite at 74.7 seconds
scenes.overlay_notes: CASE 002 / THE CRACK IS A MAP. Suppress captions for the repeated episode title phrase if necessary to prevent duplication.
scenes.shot_intent: Close the current lesson and open a new information gap for episode two without adding new technical content.
scenes.information_role: The next forensic case will read fracture evidence.

metadata.visual_motif: Thin red clearance gauge, used only in scenes 01 and 08.
metadata.caption_policy: Accessibility word captions; suppress only where exact title or episode-tease text would duplicate on-screen copy.

scene_distinctness.primary_subject: Forensic evidence title slate and brass caliper jaw
Tolerance bands and deliberate clearance band
Winning moving interface and measured gap
